items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: But he's a swell guy. He got me up, he pulled me up on a stand on the block in front of a lot of people and he gave me my life's history and all that

ctx.x: And Henning died early in life. He was a great trombonist. And Merrick played a trombone, Abby was a fine trombone, very good one. But he didn't have solidity. You know what I mean? He played in the races and he finally did union moves. But he's a swell guy. He got me up, he pulled me up on a stand on the block in front of a lot of people and he gave me my life's history and all that, and how it made you play.
